titulo: Suburban Rail Loop: Victorian government secretly increased public transport fares to help pay for controversial SRL
cuerpo: Labor put ‘levy on all public transport fares in metropolitan Melbourne and regional Victoria’ since January 2025, auditor general says Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Victorian government secretly increased public transport fares to raise money to help pay for the Suburban Rail Loop and other Big Build projects, the state’s auditor general has revealed. The auditor general’s report, tabled in parliament on Wednesday, also questioned whether the first stage of the multibillion-dollar project – a 26km stretch of twin tunnels from Cheltenham to Box Hill dubbed SRL East – can be delivered on time or within budget.
